verdictProvider: No subagent judged anything in this round; the tester's own session ran every check, so no provider or model needs naming.

implementerProof.how: I reproduced the review's path in a real browser on the builds without the fix and drove it on the head, in the server's own frame order, with only the Auth frame delayed. I also drove the stamp-then-type, ordered-list and many-reconnect cases the architect named. All of it was my own throwaway Playwright spec, not the implementer's tests.

proof.criterion: Review round 7: a writable tab reconnecting to an issue closed meanwhile never stores or counts the editor's own heading or list stamp, so a person who typed nothing sees no unsent-edit notice
proof.surface: Dispatch's Playwright harness (chromium and iphone) against the head's Go server and Postgres, with a throwaway spec that keeps the server's frame order (Sync.Step1 > Sync.Step2 > Awareness > Auth) and delays only the reconnect's Auth frame, and everything after it, by 3 s (deleted after)
proof.command: Probe 5: alice opens an open issue writable; hold and cut; the agent inserts '## Added by the agent' plus an ordered list and closes the issue; bob opens it as a read-only peer and clicks into it; alice's tab is released; during the delayed Auth, bob moves his caret and alice clicks into her page and presses ArrowLeft (no typing); read alice's heading ids, rows and status; reload; read again. bunx playwright test zz-tester-probe.e2e.ts --project chromium --project iphone --repeat-each 2 --workers 1 (DISPATCH_E2E_REUSE_SERVERS=1)
proof.observed: Head, 4 of 4: alice's editor stamped every heading id (probe, detail, added-by-the-agent); 0 rows before and after; status 'connected' with no notice, the same after the reload.
proof.negativeControl: The same probe against the web app with 83649d6a's connection.ts and pending-sync.ts failed 2 of 2, and against the 52159aaf web app failed 2 of 2. Each stored 1 row and showed 'connected · 1 edit saved in this browser can't be sent: this document is read-only.' to a person who typed nothing.

proof.criterion: A person's edit typed after stamps is kept and applies cleanly, with no heading or list item lost or doubled, whether the stamps were acknowledged online or held before Auth and never acknowledged
proof.command: Probe 6: offline, the agent inserts a heading and an ordered list; reconnect online (stamps acknowledged); cut; type; reload; release; count each heading and list item in the stored markdown. Probe 8: the same insert, but the reconnect's Auth is delayed 4 s, alice clicks before Auth (stamps held), the tab is cut before Auth arrives (never acknowledged), then she types offline, reloads and releases.
proof.observed: Head, 4 of 4 each. Probe 6 counts: typed 1, '## Server heading' 1, '## Detail' 1, 'server two' 1, 'second step' 1. Probe 8: 0 rows while the stamps were held, 26 rows after typing, 'not sent yet' shown after the reload, and once released the counts were typed 1, '## Held heading' 1, 'held two' 1, '## Detail' 1, 'second step' 1, with no rebuild notice and the rows cleared.
proof.negativeControl: Probe 6 also passes on 83649d6a, so typing was kept before the fix too; the fix's risk was losing or doubling a stamp, and none was lost or doubled.

proof.criterion: No false notice in the orders already tested (a closed document reloaded, a reopen then offline then a second close, typing after a reopen), and the held set does not grow on a tab that stays read-only across many reconnects
proof.command: Probe 1: a closed document with headings and a list, reconnected and reloaded twice. Probe 2: reopen, writable reconnect, offline, close again. Probe 3: reopen, reconnect, cut, type, reload, release. Probe 7: bob as a read-only peer; alice's read-only tab cut and reconnected 15 times; rows, status and Chromium's performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize read; then offline and a reload while held.
proof.observed: Head: probes 1, 3 and 7 4 of 4; probe 2 3 of 4. Probe 7: 0 rows and no notice after 15 reconnects, offline, and the reload; heap 20.5 to 21.7 MB. The in-memory held set itself is not observable from the page, so its size was not measured beyond the heap.
proof.negativeControl: Probe 2 failed 1 of 2 on 52159aaf (1 row after the reopen's reconnect), as in round 8.

proof.criterion: Server side after 1010687c: closes withdraw every open ask naming the closer, a reopen restores them, races stay consistent
proof.surface: dispatch:local at the head with the branch's CLI and the daemon's SetStatus
proof.command: seed.ts TT 3; closes by alice (cookie), dcli issue-update --status done and daemonclose; reopen TT-1; race.ts resolve 6, double 4, unsettled 6, flip 4
proof.observed: On each issue open_asks is 0 and the approval draft; d1 is withdrawn by alice | tester-agent-9 | legion-daemon:TT; d2 stays answered; the blocks and the copy read resolved. The reopen restored 5 asks with the blocks open. Races: 0 problems. No ERROR in the server log.

observedNotReproduced: Twice in about 60 reopen reconnects (head probe 2 on iphone; 83649d6a probe 3 on iphone) the editor was still contenteditable="false" 15 s after a reopen and a cut. A targeted loop of 66 more (probe 9: reopen, wait for the closed banner to go, cut, poll) turned writable every time, in 335 to 896 ms. No trace was captured. It also happened on 83649d6a, so this round did not bring it in.
